start_pump_at_speed.name: Start pump at speed
start_pump_at_speed.description: Synchronize the scheduled Pool Filtration RPM. A stopped or priming pump aligns its manual setpoint after priming, correcting an older speed restored by TCX unless another cloud client sends a conflicting manual-speed command; a running pump updates both targets immediately.

rpm.name: Filtration preset
rpm.description: Scheduled Pool Filtration RPM to persist and apply.

get_native_schedules.name: Get native schedules
get_native_schedules.description: Request a fresh complete Authorization schedule snapshot, including an empty table. Available with experimental writes disabled. Does not send equipment or schedule writes.

config_entry_id.name: TCX controller
config_entry_id.description: Select the TCX Direct integration entry.

source.name: Snapshot source
source.description: WebSocket Authorization is the default and requests a new complete schedule snapshot. REST is an explicit alternative only when its response includes a schedule table; missing data is never treated as empty.

preview_native_schedule.name: Preview native schedule
preview_native_schedule.description: Preview one experimental Pool Filtration schedule change using a new complete Authorization snapshot, without writing it. New entries default to disabled. Review the response before applying.

config_entry_id.name: TCX controller
config_entry_id.description: Select the TCX Direct integration entry.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: Create, update, enable, disable, or delete one schedule.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: Numbered ID from Get native schedules. Omit when creating.

start.name: Start time
start.description: Controller-local clock time in HH:MM, without seconds. Required when creating.

end.name: End time
end.description: Controller-local HH:MM. Overnight entries can only be stored disabled until validated.

weekday_codes.name: Weekday codes
weekday_codes.description: List of distinct protocol integers 0–6. Friday = 5 is confirmed; other individual mappings remain unverified.

rpm.name: Schedule RPM
rpm.description: Explicit whole-number RPM within the controller's limits. Zero/default-speed writes are unsupported.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: New schedules default to false. Enabling can cause equipment to run immediately if the interval is active.

apply_native_schedule.name: Apply native schedule
apply_native_schedule.description: Apply a reviewed, single-use preview. Requires experimental writes enabled in options, Auto mode, and an unchanged new Authorization schedule snapshot. Success requires reported confirmation and another complete Authorization readback. Never retries an uncertain write.

config_entry_id.name: TCX controller
config_entry_id.description: Select the TCX Direct integration entry.

plan_id.name: Preview ID
plan_id.description: Single-use plan ID returned by Preview native schedule. Expires after five minutes.

acknowledge_native_schedule_write.name: Acknowledge uncertain schedule write
acknowledge_native_schedule_write.description: Revalidate the reviewed schedule revision with another fresh snapshot before clearing the write block. Authorization sends only a read-only subscription, never an equipment write. A matching pending operation is required; there is no force clear or replay.

config_entry_id.name: TCX controller
config_entry_id.description: Select the TCX Direct integration entry.

plan_id.name: Pending operation ID
plan_id.description: plan_id from pending_write in Get native schedules. Recovery remains available after the original preview expires.

revision.name: Reviewed revision
revision.description: Revision returned by Get native schedules after you have checked the uncertain result in iAquaLink.

source.name: Snapshot source
source.description: Use the same source as the reviewed read. A new snapshot is required again; no cached or unverified force-clear is permitted.

user.title: Connect to iAquaLink
user.description: This integration connects directly to the Zodiac/iAquaLink cloud. No Home Assistant add-on is required.

device.title: Select AquaLink TCX
device.description: More than one TCX controller was found.

error.no_tcx_devices: The account connected successfully, but no AquaLink TCX device was found.
error.device_not_found: The configured TCX controller was not found on this account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This AquaLink TCX is already configured.

init.title: Experimental native schedules
init.description: Leave disabled for normal operation. Opting in permits explicitly previewed schedule writes, which can start equipment. No HA timetable is migrated, disabled, or uploaded automatically. Use only during supervised development testing.
